title: 绿洲 UI-4.2 全页面样品
scope: 当前已实现绿洲页面及主要交互状态；原生功能沿用宿主，只展示入口与衔接。未接入模板不视为已实现。
stylePrompt:
Create a high-fidelity static Chinese desktop UI EXAMPLE in the attached chosen Green Oasis UI-4.2 style. Current date 2026-10-15 Asia/Shanghai. The reference is the current chosen visual TARGET, not source code. Match restrained green #196e55, white/light gray surfaces, system Chinese typography, thin dividers, minimal border radius, comfortable readable 14–16px body type, purposeful spacing. This is inside an existing DSH professional plugin; preserve existing host ownership. NO unrelated dashboard, metrics, decorative illustrations, gradients, nested cards or giant app heading. One focused screen per image, no montage, no option numbers.
GLOBAL USER REQUIREMENTS: the native file tab is the ONLY place for the name 绿洲专业工作台; NEVER repeat it as a page heading. Under native tabs use ONE compact working toolbar containing minimal 功能中心 navigation, current task 权利要求书生成 with small close/+ affordances when relevant, next-generation source 本地 Skills / 专业 API. No extra subtitle, project id, date, readiness/status banner. Absolutely NO settings button, settings gear, settings menu, settings link, account controls or configuration status strip in the business workspace. Settings are ONLY inside DSH's existing native settings region; a page explicitly designated NATIVE SETTINGS below may show the actual account form there. No duplication of credentials/model/layout configuration elsewhere.
Shared material fields are EXACTLY 技术交底 / 附图说明 / 撰写要求 / 用户指令, in that order. Input is one shared form for BOTH sources, never two API/local panels. In narrow layout 输入 / 结果 are distinct OUTER view tabs, not a fifth material field. Current result version selector always independently states its original source; source switch controls only next generation. Independent bounded scroll regions, fixed reachable bottom operations. Known outcomes must stay precise: unknown is not failure, stopping wait is not backend cancellation/refund, no automatic retry or source switch; prepared conversation data is NOT sent. Review applies only to fixed version; edit makes a new unreviewed version; no-overwrite save manifest/confirmation is retained.
All content/statuses/file names below are SYNTHETIC DESIGN EXAMPLES, NOT live acceptance or actual costs. Use the public synthetic disclosure: controller writes a new log data segment, checks checksum, updates one of two alternating index slots, writes index contents before commit marker, startup uses valid newer index and falls back to old slot if interrupted. Do NOT invent unsupported numerical parameters or claim legal/patent success. Do NOT display credentials, JWT, API origin inputs, independent save directories, local-real-model enable checkbox, project API binding form, provider marketplace, billing/accounting, extra templates as available, automatic send/refund/cancel.
Prefer concise relevant text at point of action, not a global explanatory header. Labels must be legible Chinese, exact sensible semantics. No view-level app title added. A modal may have one concise functional heading for accessibility. No numbered concepts or commentary labels in the image.

A small 从网站导入 action sits on the right in this functional row. Below a compact category tab strip 技术研发 / 专利撰写 / 辅助工具 with 专利撰写 selected. A clean flat task list: 权利要求书生成 active/openable with 打开→; 说明书生成 disabled 待接入; 申请文件检查 disabled 待接入. Only the first template is supported. 01-function-center.note: 原生功能入口、网站导入与已接入模板；其余模板保持待接入。

06-unknown.title: 超时后状态未确认
06-unknown.brief: Target1152x896 wide, source and input frozen/disabled, selected record v5 · 本地 Skills · 状态未确认. Right primary small amber notice 状态未确认, concise line 本地等待已超时，尚未取得有效正文. Smaller text 原请求结果未知；不自动重发或切换来源. Folded 调用记录 details, code TIMED_OUT in secondary typography, never a giant diagnostic wall. Only 查看原运行 action. NO retry/regenerate/recover-response buttons, no provider cancellation/refund or charge conclusion. Historical version selector can still indicate older approved versions without mutating unknown run. Pending run does not become failure or success. Calm context-specific warning, minimal top chrome.
06-unknown.note: 保留未知，不重发、不切源；没有正文时不提供审核或保存。

Explain 本地草稿仍保留，系统不会自动覆盖. Native server revision36 vs local35 displayed in small contextual text, not diagnostics wall. Show a short read-only local draft excerpt beneath so it feels retained. One explicit outlined action 重新载入服务端版本（舍弃本地草稿） with a nearby consequence statement, not an auto-refresh. No automatic merge, no new merge platform or artificial comparison editor. No generate/save/force-overwrite buttons while conflicting; no settings entry. Error content uses whitespace, not giant status illustrations or duplicated headings.
19-sync-conflict.note: 操作前保留本地草稿；明确重新载入会舍弃本地草稿。
